It’s simple: every tax-paying American citizen deserves to have their voice heard, and only tax-paying American citizens should have the right and responsibility to exercise their vote. This commonsense reform is not political or controversial. It ensures every US citizen, regardless of political affiliation, has the unequivocal right to vote while reinforcing election integrity by strictly prohibiting non-citizens from participating in tax-payer funded elections.

I was thrilled to help celebrate the grand opening of two outstanding new businesses in Newtown—please join me in welcoming Beyond Zen Skin and Revive Hive Wellness Lounge to our incredible PA-1 small business community! 

Small businesses like these are the backbone of our local economy, and I will always be a champion for the hard-working local entrepreneurs who help our community grow and thrive.

A child's potential is directly linked to the nutrition they receive. That’s why I am committed to ensuring every student in PA-1 and nationwide has daily access to fresh, nutritious, and unprocessed food. 

As part of my ongoing efforts, I introduced the Scratch Cooked Meals for Students Act, which establishes a USDA grant program that incentivizes schools to prepare meals from fresh, locally sourced ingredients, setting our children on the path to healthier lifestyles and the Early Childhood Nutrition Improvement Act, which allows child care providers to receive reimbursement for an extra meal under the Child and Adult Care Food Program for children in care for over eight hours. By streamlining reimbursement processes, we make it easier for providers to deliver wholesome meals.

Together, these initiatives elevate meal quality and prioritize the health of our children. I will always fight for the kids of PA-1, and ensure they have the nutritious food they need to thrive and succeed!

Proud to help welcome another incredible small business to our PA-1 community! Elena Leva is the founder of Vici Wellness Studio in Newtown, and her vision is to make health accessible to everyone. As a first-generation Italian, Elena draws inspiration from her heritage and the principles of Blue Zones, promoting a lifestyle that fosters longevity, well-being, and joy. 

Small businesses like Vici are the backbone of our community, and when they succeed, we all benefit. Congratulations to Elena and the entire Vici team—I look forward to supporting you in your future endeavors, and thank you for investing in our community!

Being named a #Champion4Children by @Campaign4Kids is both an honor and responsibility I hold close to my heart. Since entering Congress, I have made it a priority to champion legislation and initiatives that protect our children’s health, education, nutrition, and safety. But our mission is far from over. Rising costs, threats to healthcare, and new risks to their safety mean we must continue pushing forward with even greater resolve. I remain committed making our children’s well-being and safety a steadfast national priority. I will always stand up for them, today and every day.
